note: Every release before 2.1.1 deserializes ObjectMessage bodies with BinaryFormatter in ActiveMQObjectMessage.get_Body (present in 2.0.1 and 2.1.0). 2.1.0 added an allow/deny filter, TrustedClassFilter.BindToType and NmsDefaultDeserializationPolicy.IsTrustedType, which could be bypassed; those two exist only from 2.1.0. Reached wherever the client reads an ObjectMessage from a broker.
